description: This file contains JavaScript code for managing dashboard and dashlet interactions in SuiteCRM, including layout management, dashlet configuration, retrieval, addition, deletion, and UI dialogs.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the current layout of dashlets, either as a string or array.

methods.name: onDrag
methods.description: Handles the event when a dashlet is picked up for dragging.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Handles the event when a dashlet is dropped, saving the new layout if changed.

methods.name: saveLayout
methods.description: Saves the current dashlet layout via an AJAX POST request.

methods.name: uncoverPage
methods.description: Hides configuration dialog and retrieves dashlet content.

methods.name: configureDashlet
methods.description: Opens a dialog to configure a specific dashlet.

methods.name: retrieveDashlet
methods.description: Fetches and updates the content of a dashlet via AJAX.

methods.name: setChooser
methods.description: Sets the display and hide column configurations.

methods.name: deleteDashlet
methods.description: Removes a dashlet after user confirmation.

methods.name: addDashlet
methods.description: Adds a new dashlet to the layout, loads its content, and makes it draggable.

methods.name: retrieveCurrentPage
methods.description: Loads a specific dashboard page.

methods.name: showDashletsDialog
methods.description: Displays the dialog for selecting dashlets.

methods.name: closeDashletsDialog
methods.description: Closes the dashlets selection dialog.

methods.name: toggleDashletCategories
methods.description: Switches between dashlet categories in the UI.

methods.name: searchDashlets
methods.description: Performs a search for dashlets based on input string and category.

methods.name: collapseList
methods.description: Collapses a list view in the UI.

methods.name: expandList
methods.description: Expands a list view in the UI.

methods.name: collapseReportList
methods.description: Collapses report dashlet list.

methods.name: expandReportList
methods.description: Expands report dashlet list.

methods.name: clearSearch
methods.description: Clears the dashlet search input and resets category view.

methods.name: doneAddDashlets
methods.description: Hides the dashlets dialog after adding dashlets.

methods.name: refreshPageForAnalytics
methods.description: Reloads the page, typically after analytics updates.

methods.name: renderDashletsDialog
methods.description: Initializes and displays the dashlets selection dialog with dynamic height.
